Transformation for fractional polynomial

```{r}
stable_boxcox <- function(x, p) {
  log_x = log(x);
  if (abs(p) < 1e-7) {
    o = log_x * (1.0 + p*log_x/2.0 + p*p*log_x*log_x/6.0);
  } else {
    o = (x^p - 1.0) / p;
  }
  o
}
x <- 1:80
plot(x, stable_boxcox(x, 0))
lines(x, log(x))
plotl(x, stable_boxcox(x, 2))
```

```{cpp}
#include <TMB.hpp>

// --- Helper functions for stable computation ---

// Numerically stable Box-Cox transformation H(x,p) = (x^p - 1)/p
template<class Type>
Type stable_boxcox(Type x, Type p) {
  Type log_x = log(x);
  // For p ≈ 0, use Taylor series expansion of (exp(p*log_x) - 1) / p
  if (abs(p * log_x) < 1e-7) {
    return log_x * (1.0 + p*log_x/2.0 + p*p*log_x*log_x/6.0);
  } else {
    return (pow(x, p) - 1.0) / p;
  }
}

// Numerically stable divided difference of the Box-Cox transformation
template<class Type>
Type stable_boxcox_div_diff(Type x, Type p1, Type p2) {
  Type delta = p2 - p1;
  // For p1 ≈ p2, use the derivative dH/dp
  if (abs(delta) < 1e-7) {
    Type p = p1;
    Type log_x = log(x);
    // Derivative needs its own stable implementation for p ≈ 0
    if (abs(p) < 1e-7) {
        return 0.5 * log_x * log_x;
    } else {
        return (p * pow(x, p) * log_x - (pow(x, p) - 1.0)) / (p*p);
    }
  } else {
    return (stable_boxcox(x, p2) - stable_boxcox(x, p1)) / delta;
  }
}


template<class Type>
Type objective_function<Type>::operator() () {
  // Data
  DATA_VECTOR(y);
  DATA_MATRIX(X); // Predictor(s)
  int x_col = 0; // Assuming first column of X is the variable of interest

  // Predefined set of powers
  DATA_VECTOR(S); // e.g., {-2, -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3}

  // Parameters
  PARAMETER_VECTOR(beta);   // beta_0, beta_1, beta_2
  PARAMETER(log_sigma);
  PARAMETER(p1_raw);
  PARAMETER(p2_raw);

  // Use raw parameters directly to allow sampling on N(0,1)
  Type p1 = p1_raw;
  Type p2 = p2_raw;

  // FP Basis calculation
  vector<Type> x = X.col(x_col);
  vector<Type> B1(x.size());
  vector<Type> B2(x.size());
  for(int i=0; i<x.size(); ++i) {
    B1(i) = stable_boxcox(x(i), p1);
    B2(i) = stable_boxcox_div_diff(x(i), p1, p2);
  }

  // Linear predictor
  vector<Type> eta = beta(0) + beta(1) * B1 + beta(2) * B2;

  // Likelihood
  Type nll = -sum(dnorm(y, eta, exp(log_sigma), true));

  // Penalty to encourage powers towards set S
  Type sigma_penalty = 0.1; // small value, can be fixed or estimated
  Type p1_penalty = 0.0;
  Type p2_penalty = 0.0;
  for (int j=0; j<S.size(); ++j) {
      p1_penalty += exp(-0.5 * pow((p1 - S(j))/sigma_penalty, 2.0));
      p2_penalty += exp(-0.5 * pow((p2 - S(j))/sigma_penalty, 2.0));
  }
  // Subtract from NLL as this is a log-prior
  nll -= log(p1_penalty);
  nll -= log(p2_penalty);

  return nll;
}
```
